column5: Look: the spike's tilted 2.5D cartoon galley: pale steel counters with orange trim, a dark plated floor, portholes onto a ringed planet and stars, chunky orange-suited cooks; red alarm lights pulse before gravity cuts out. Each galley has its own trim colour and view out the window. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
